from datetime import datetime, timedelta

catalog = pd.read_csv(CATALOG_CSV)
values = pd.read_csv(VALUES_CSV)

# Merge to get label for each point
timeseries_info = catalog.merge(values, on='timeseries_id')
timeseries_info['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(timeseries_info['timestamp'])

start_time = datetime(2018, 4, 13)
end_time = start_time + timedelta(days=1)

filtered_values = timeseries_info[(timeseries_info['timestamp'] >= start_time) & 
                                    (timeseries_info['timestamp'] < end_time)]

# Compute energy by zone
filtered_values['value'] = filtered_values['value'].astype(float)
energy_by_zone = filtered_values.groupby('point_uri')['value'].sum()

# Select the zone which used the most energy
max_energy_zone, max_energy = energy_by_zone.idxmax(), energy_by_zone.max()

max_energy_zone_name = catalog[catalog['point_uri'] == max_energy_zone]['point_label'].iloc[0]
print(max_energy_zone_name)
